prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1301; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute low back strain and paraspinal muscle tenderness. Over the course of 17 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the collision, and the clinical picture aligns with the symptoms described. Several examination findings, including reduced lumbar range of motion and localized muscle guarding, support the presence of a soft tissue injury, while neurological screening and straight leg raise testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same region of the back is known. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and function returned. Billed services correspond to the care documented, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged to independent home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
